# Ankura

> > Ankura is a global business advisory and expert services firm providing consulting in financial, operational, technology, and risk management domains.

Ankura Consulting Group delivers specialized expertise across industries including construction, transportation, and financial services. The firm operates globally with offices in major cities including Washington D.C., New York, Boston, London, Chicago, and Atlanta, offering services from audit advisory and solution implementation to forensics and regulatory compliance.

## Key Topics

- Ankura Consulting Group
- Expert witnesses and advisors
- Construction advisory and consulting
- Financial crime and AML compliance
- CFO and finance transformation
- Regulatory compliance (SEC, PCAOB)
- eDiscovery services
- ERP and digital transformation
- Arbitration and dispute resolution
- Industry recognition (Who's Who Legal)
- Transportation and logistics consulting
- Audit advisory services
- Risk management
- Supply chain consulting

## Advisory Services

- [Audit Advisory](https://www.ankura.com/services/audit-advisory): Audit advisory services for SEC, PCAOB compliance and quality control
- [Solution Implementation](https://www.ankura.com/services/solution-implementation): Technology solution implementation and ERP digital transformation services
- [Transportation & Logistics](https://www.ankura.com/industries/transportation-and-logistics): Transportation & logistics consulting for supply chain and infrastructure
